newsitem.title: USA: Toreador CEO resigns, board oks buyback.
newsitem.headline: Toreador CEO resigns, board oks buyback.

text.p: Toreador Royalty Corp said Monday that Peter Vig, its chairman and chief executive, had resigned to become a managing director of Tiger Management LLC, an investment management firm in New York City.
The company said John Mark McLaughlin, a Toreador director, was named chairman and president, and said Vig would remain a Toreador director.
Additionally, the company said Donald August had also resigned as a company director.
The board also announced the authorization of a 300,000 share repurchase plan.
Toreador owns more than 530,000 net mineral acres primarily in Texas and owns working or royalty interests in Texas, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Arkansas and Louisiana.
